Kit summary

Bug SuctionBasic
Deals 210% ATK DMG to a single enemy and restores self HP by 60% of the DMG dealt by this attack. The restoration effect is doubled if the target has any attribute debuff.
Bug RingActiveExclusive Lv.1
There is a 70% chance to inflict [Severe Wound] on an enemy target and 2 random enemies for 2 turns, then deals 200% ATK DMG.
Bug Antennae Lv.1Bug Ring: The skill now targets all enemies instead.
Bug BirthPassiveExclusive Lv.3
Jennifer gains [Dormancy] at the beginning of each wave, taking 28% less DMG, the effect of which is reduced by 25% every turn. Meanwhile, Jennifer gains [Bug Hum], which increases her Direct DMG dealt by the same amount as the DMG reduction effect of [Dormancy]. Jennifer gains 10% Leech and immediately cleanses all her debuffs when [Dormancy] has been fully converted to [Bug Hum], then she casts Bug Dance 1 more time. Afterward, Jennifer casts Bug Dance 1 more time every 5 turns.
Bug Antennae Lv.3The DMG reduction effect is lost, but the Direct DMG increase effect remains the same while [Dormancy] is being converted to [Bug Hum]. The Leech is increased by 15% when [Dormancy] has been fully converted to [Bug Hum].
Bug DanceActiveExclusive Lv.2
Deals 3 stages of 130% ATK DMG each to all enemies, then grants self [Stealth] for 1 turn.
Bug Antennae Lv.2Bug Dance: Before dealing DMG, there is a 40% chance to reduce all enemies' DEF by 60% for 2 turns. This chance increases to 60% if [Dormancy] has been fully converted to [Bug Hum].
